import * as C from "@constants";
import { Callout } from "@stainless-api/docs/components";
import DoWithAi from "@components/DoWithAi.astro";
import TestPlan from "@components/TestPlan.astro";

Row deletes use the standard [`DELETE`](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/sql-delete.html) statement against a {C.HYPERTABLE}. This works the same whether the {C.CHUNK} is in the {C.ROWSTORE} or the {C.COLUMNSTORE}. You don't
need to decompress a {C.CHUNK} before deleting from it: {C.TIMESCALE_DB} decompresses only the rows your
statement touches, not the whole {C.CHUNK}. When you need to age out large ranges, dropping {C.CHUNK}s or using a retention policy is usually cheaper than massive `DELETE` scans.

<DoWithAi />

## Delete data with DELETE command

To delete data from a table, use the syntax `DELETE FROM ...`. In this example,
data is deleted from the table `conditions`, if the row's `temperature` or
`humidity` is below a certain level:

```sql
DELETE FROM conditions WHERE temperature < 35 OR humidity < 60;
```

<Callout variant="tip">
If you delete a lot of data, run
[`VACUUM`](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/sql-vacuum.html) or
`VACUUM FULL` to reclaim storage from the deleted or obsolete rows.
</Callout>

## Delete data by dropping chunks

{C.TIMESCALE_DB} allows you to delete data by age, by dropping {C.CHUNK}s from a
{C.HYPERTABLE}. You can do so either manually or by data retention policy.

To learn more, see the [data retention section](/learn/data-lifecycle/data-retention/about-data-retention).

<TestPlan>
target: cloud, self-hosted

1. fork the service
2. [cloud] select the service
3. [self-hosted] run SQL: `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS timescaledb;`
4. run SQL: `CREATE TABLE conditions (time timestamptz NOT NULL, location text, temperature double precision, humidity double precision) WITH (tsdb.hypertable, tsdb.partition_column = 'time');`
5. run SQL: `INSERT INTO conditions (time, location, temperature, humidity) VALUES (now() - INTERVAL '4 hours', 'office', 70.0, 65.0), (now() - INTERVAL '3 hours', 'garage', 30.0, 70.0), (now() - INTERVAL '2 hours', 'basement', 66.0, 40.0), (now() - INTERVAL '1 hour', 'lab', 34.9, 59.9);`
6. run SQL: `DELETE FROM conditions WHERE temperature < 35 OR humidity < 60;`
7. expect no rows: `SELECT 1 FROM conditions WHERE temperature < 35 OR humidity < 60`
8. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM conditions WHERE location = 'office' HAVING count(*) = 1`
9. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM conditions HAVING count(*) = 1`

Not scripted: Delete data by dropping chunks: the section links to the data retention pages, whose plans cover it.
</TestPlan>
